description: A long blue-grey crossed-front steppe coat with narrow gold knotwork trim on the front overlap, sleeve edges and hem, layered over cream/grey sleeves and tan trousers. A broad decorated brown leather sash-belt with round metal fittings and hanging tassels secures the waist. Brown leather wrist cuffs and tall brown boots complete the mobile noble outfit. No headgear, armor or weapons are present.
